not_met.lacks: Writing a product vision trial, the developer can't tell when it passes beyond the runs coming through every step. The figure at dev/rn/images/tests.svg:168-174 has a stand-in for each deliverable's people judge KR1.1 by using it, and measures KR1.2 and KR1.3 against the last trial's. It doesn't say whether a run fails the trial when that stand-in couldn't use the deliverable, or when KR1.2 or KR1.3 got worse. So a failing trial can't name the use it breaks, and a trial can pass while the people can't use what rn handed over. Unit and architecture give what runs real, the doubles, the coverage and what each test checks, at dev/rn/images/tests.svg:149-161 and dev/rn/architecture.md:853-858.
